title: BANXE UI/UX Audit — Findings / Evidence Envelope
description: Evidence envelope for the Consolidated UI/UX Audit Block (docs/governance/UIUX-AUDIT-BLOCK-SPEC.md, #916). banxe-ui emits this envelope; the factory ingests it read-only. P0 artefact — schema only; no runner, no uiux-pipeline.sh edit. Absence/staleness of evidence => status 'unknown', NEVER 'pass'.

contract_version.description: Version of the cross-repo runtime contract this envelope conforms to (contract authored in P1; NOT created in P0).

commit_sha.description: banxe-ui frontend commit the evidence was generated against (freshness check: must match the audited frontend revision).

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the evidence was produced.

results.description: One entry per audited requirement (static or runtime).

requirement.description: Audited requirement id, e.g. axe_core_wcag_aa, viewport_matrix, keyboard_focus, visual_regression, state_coverage, key_journeys, mobile_web_parity, tokens, components, drift, duplication.

status.description: Conformance status. DEFAULT and MANDATORY fallback is 'unknown' — used whenever evidence is absent or stale. 'pass' MUST NOT be asserted without a fresh artefact_ref.

severity.description: Whether a failing result blocks promotion. Hard gates (axe-core/WCAG 2.1 AA, ADR-102 duplication, unsourced-variant) = blocking; runtime requirements other than axe-core remain advisory until the banxe-ui runtime exists; stylistic drift = advisory. Authoritative map: docs/governance/UIUX-GATE-POLICY.md.

artefact_ref.description: Reference to the supporting evidence artefact (e.g. axe report, screenshot diff, Playwright run). Absent => status MUST be 'unknown'.
